why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: Open app.allox.ai and log in with email, Google or Apple, which creates a wallet for you. You can connect MetaMask, Binance Wallet, OKX, Trust or another wallet instead.
Claim the 5,000-point welcome bonus. The app only releases it to a wallet that has made a transaction and holds a small balance on Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain or Solana.
Claim the daily bonus on the Rewards page once a day. On Ethereum, BNB Chain or Base each claim is a transaction and costs gas.
Link X and Telegram on the Rewards page and do the social tasks.
Check the Campaigns page to see what is open.
